lines.speaker: header

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: Him.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What do you mean, pressuring him?

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: In talking to him.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: No we told him we needed to know the truth. We've been doing this job a long time Barb and we can tell when people aren't telling the truth. And, in my opinion, he'd never be able to live with himself if he didn't tell somebody. There's no way, he could've live with that. Nobody could live with that. I think Brendan knows that.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Brendan, you need to use the bathroom or anything? (Brendan shakes head "no")

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: When are you going out to my house then?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: As soon as we can leave here, we'll go out there. I don't think we're gonna bring Brendan out there though. I-I just don't think that's a good idea. I don't think he needs to be exposed to that or be out there anymore. (door opens and closes) It's not gonna do him any good.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: So what you're sayin' is if, when he gets out, it wouldn't be a good idea for him to be there, at all.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: I-You know, I can't tell you where for you guys to live, but what do you think? Do you think it's a good idea for him to next where this stuff occurred?

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: I-I don't wanna be there, but I can't afford another place.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: I mean that's $80,000 I owe yet.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: It's a shitty, shitty spot to be in.

lines.speaker: BARB JANDA
lines.text: And nobody's gonna buy it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You're in a bad spot an-and I wish I had some answers for you. If there's somethin' I can do to help ya, I certainly will. (pause) Maybe you should look into movin' the house.
